shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at the origin on the left with the mark at 1 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed function has no value at x=0. Right image: The displayed set excludes 1 at its lower bound.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=0. On the right, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray.
